title: Freya and the Asset
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Ivo Winterbourne, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
